question: Who among the following is associated with the badminton game?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Pramod Bhagat**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Pramod Bhagat** is a renowned Indian para-badminton player who has achieved international recognition for his exceptional skills and contributions to the sport.
 
• He is a recipient of the **Arjuna Award**, which is one of India's highest honors in sports, given for outstanding performance.
 
• Pramod Bhagat won a historic **gold medal in the Tokyo Paralympics 2020** in the SL3 category, making India proud and bringing para-badminton into the spotlight globally.
 
• He specializes in the SL3 category of para-badminton, which is for athletes with lower limb impairments that affect their ability to walk or run.
 
• Pramod Bhagat has been actively contributing to the development and promotion of para-badminton in India, inspiring many young athletes with disabilities to take up the sport.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Badminton as a Sport:**

 
 
• Badminton is a popular racket sport played worldwide and involves players hitting a shuttlecock across a net.
 
• It is an Olympic sport and has various formats like singles, doubles, and mixed doubles.
 
• India has produced many renowned badminton players such as **P.V. Sindhu**, **Saina Nehwal**, and **Kidambi Srikanth**, who have achieved global success.
 
 
 
• **Para-Badminton:**
 
 
• Para-badminton is an adaptation of badminton for athletes with physical disabilities, governed by the **Badminton World Federation (BWF)**.
 
• It has multiple classifications based on the type and severity of disability, including wheelchair and standing categories.
 
• India has emerged as a strong contender in para-badminton, with players like **Pramod Bhagat** and **Sujit Munda** achieving international accolades.
 
 
 
• **Other Mentioned Personalities:**
 
 
• **Sumit Antil:** He is a celebrated Indian para-athlete specializing in javelin throw. He won a gold medal at the **Tokyo Paralympics 2020**.
 
• **Amit Kumar Saroha:** A renowned Indian para-athlete in the field of club throw and discus throw, he has represented India in multiple international events.
 
• **Devendra Jhajharia:** An iconic Indian javelin thrower, he is the first Indian para-athlete to win two gold medals at the Paralympics.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• **Pramod Bhagat’s Achievements:**

 
 
• He has won multiple medals in **World Championships**, Asian Championships, and other international tournaments.
 
• He was honored with the **Major Dhyan Chand Khel Ratna Award** in 2021 for his outstanding achievements in para-badminton.
 
• He continues to be a role model for aspiring para-athletes and contributes to the growth of the sport in India.
 
 
 
• **Significance of Para-Badminton:**
 
 
• It provides a platform for athletes with disabilities to showcase their talent and compete at the highest level.
 
• The inclusion of para-badminton in the **Paralympics** has significantly boosted its popularity and recognition globally.
 
• India’s success in para-badminton highlights the growing support and infrastructure for para-sports in the country.
